Input Constraints¶

Field combinations

At most one of name or name-prefix.

At most one of rules or rules-json.

Capacity rules

Requirement.

Rule logic
Require
input.capacity >= 1

Scope rules

Requirement.

Rule logic
Require
input.scope == 'REGIONAL'
|| input.scope == 'CLOUDFRONT'

Name rules

If set, name must match the specified pattern.

Rule logic
Require
@core.is-match(input.name, '^[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,128}$')

Name prefix rules

If set, name-prefix must match the specified pattern.

Rule logic
Require
@core.is-match(input.name-prefix, '^[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,102}$')

Visibility config rules

If set, visibility-config.metric-name must match the specified pattern.

Rule logic
Require
@core.is-match(input.visibility-config.metric-name, '^[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,128}$')

visibility-config cloudwatch-metrics-enabled must be set.

Rule logic
Require
input.visibility-config.cloudwatch-metrics-enabled != null

visibility-config sampled-requests-enabled must be set.

Rule logic
Require
input.visibility-config.sampled-requests-enabled != null

Description rules

Conditional requirement.

Rule logic
When
input.description != null
Require
@core.byte-length(input.description) >= 1
&& @core.byte-length(input.description) <= 256

Rules json rules

If set, rules-json must be valid JSON text.

Rule logic
Require
@core.is-format(input.rules-json, 'json')

Custom response bodies rules

custom-response-bodies contains an invalid key, content or type.

Rule logic
For each
input.custom-response-bodies ?? {}
Require
@core.is-match(@each.key, '^[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,128}$')
&& @core.byte-length(@each.value.content) >= 1
&& @core.byte-length(@each.value.content) <= 10240
&& (@each.value.content-type == 'TEXT_PLAIN' || @each.value.content-type == 'TEXT_HTML' || @each.value.content-type == 'APPLICATION_JSON')

Rules rules

Exactly one of rules[*].action.allow, rules[*].action.block, rules[*].action.captcha, rules[*].action.challenge, or rules[*].action.count.

rule name must be 1 to 128 bytes.

Rule logic
For each
input.rules ?? []
Require
@core.byte-length(@each.value.name) >= 1
&& @core.byte-length(@each.value.name) <= 128

rule visibility metric-name must use 1 to 128 name characters.

Rule logic
For each
input.rules ?? []
Require
@core.is-match(@each.value.visibility-config.metric-name, '^[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,128}$')

rule priority must be set.

Rule logic
For each
input.rules ?? []
Require
@each.value.priority != null

rule visibility cloudwatch-metrics-enabled must be set.

Rule logic
For each
input.rules ?? []
Require
@each.value.visibility-config.cloudwatch-metrics-enabled != null

rule visibility sampled-requests-enabled must be set.

Rule logic
For each
input.rules ?? []
Require
@each.value.visibility-config.sampled-requests-enabled != null

rule-label name must use 1 to 1024 label characters.

Rule logic
For each
@rule in input.rules ?? []
@label in @rule.value.rule-labels ?? []
Require
@core.is-match(@label.value.name, '^[0-9A-Za-z_:-]+$')
&& @core.byte-length(@label.value.name) <= 1024

rule action contains an invalid custom HTTP header or response.

input.rules ?? []
Require
( @core.all( [ for request in [ @each.value.action.allow?.custom-request-handling, @each.value.action.captcha?.custom-request-handling, @each.value.action.challenge?.custom-request-handling, @each.value.action.count?.custom-request-handling, ] : ( @core.length(request.insert-headers) >= 1 && @core.all( [ for headers in [request.insert-headers] : @core.all( [ for header in headers : ( @core.is-match(header.name, '^[0-9A-Za-z_$.-]{1,64}$') && @core.byte-length(header.value) >= 1 && @core.byte-length(header.value) <= 255 ) ], ) ], ) ) when request != null ], ) && @core.all( [ for response in [@each.value.action.block?.custom-response] : ( response.response-code >= 200 && response.response-code <= 600 && @core.is-match(response.custom-response-body-key, '^[0-9A-Za-z_-]{1,128}$') && @core.all( [ for headers in [response.response-headers ?? []] : @core.all( [ for header in headers : ( @core.is-match(header.name, '^[0-9A-Za-z_$.-]{1,64}$') && @core.byte-length(header.value) >= 1 && @core.byte-length(header.value) <= 255 ) ], ) ], ) ) when response != null ], ) )
